achilles.description:
by default, Achilles connects to the same DB that the WebAPI uses
this assumes that it contains both the WebAPI schema (`ohdsi`) as well
as any CDM schemas. See <https://github.com/OHDSI/Broadsea-Achilles> for details on the container used.

cdmVersion.description: version of the CDM. Equivalent to the Achilles `ACHILLES_CDM_VERSION` env var.

enabled.description: whether or not to enable the Achilles cron job. Make sure to set the `schemas` below to point to an existing CDM.

extraEnv.description: extra environment variables to pass to the Achilles container

failedJobsHistoryLimit.description: The number of failed finished jobs to retain. Value must be non-negative integer.

podAnnotations.description: annotations applied to the pod managed by this CronJob

resources.description: configure the resource requests and limits

resourcesPreset.description:
set container resources according to one common preset (allowed values: none, nano, micro, small, medium, large, xlarge, 2xlarge). This is ignored if primary.resources is set (primary.resources is recommended for production).
More information: <https://github.com/chgl/charts/blob/master/charts/common/templates/_resources.tpl>

schedule.description: when to run the Achilles job. See <https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/cron-jobs/#cron-schedule-syntax>

cdm.description: name of the schema containing the OMOP CDM. Equivalent to the Achilles `ACHILLES_CDM_SCHEMA` env var.

res.description: name of the schema containing the cohort generation results. Equivalent to the Achilles `ACHILLES_RES_SCHEMA` env var.

vocab.description: name of the schema containing the vocabulary. Equivalent to the Achilles `ACHILLES_VOCAB_SCHEMA` env var.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the service account

automountServiceAccountToken.description: whether to automount the SA token

create.description: Specifies whether a service account should be created.

name.description:
The name of the service account to use.
If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template

sourceName.description: the CDM source name. Equivalent to the Achilles `ACHILLES_SOURCE` env var.

successfulJobsHistoryLimit.description: The number of successful finished jobs to retain. Value must be non-negative integer.

config.description: override the config files to configure Atlas

local.description:
the contents of the `config-local.json` file. See
<https://github.com/OHDSI/Atlas3/blob/develop/public/config-local.example.json> for an example.
If unset, a config is generated which points to the WebAPI and enables user authentication
if any of the `webApi.auth` providers is enabled.

nodeSelector.description:
node labels for pods assignment
see: <https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/scheduling-eviction/assign-pod-node/>

enabled.description:
create a PodDisruptionBudget resource for the OHDSI Atlas pods.
Configure it using either `minAvailable` (default: `1`) or `maxUnavailable`, both accept a number or a percentage.

maxUnavailable.description: Maximum unavailable instances; ignored if there is no PodDisruptionBudget

minAvailable.description: Minimum available instances; ignored if there is no PodDisruptionBudget

resources.description: configure the resource requests and limits

resourcesPreset.description:
set container resources according to one common preset (allowed values: none, nano, micro, small, medium, large, xlarge, 2xlarge). This is ignored if primary.resources is set (primary.resources is recommended for production).
More information: <https://github.com/chgl/charts/blob/master/charts/common/templates/_resources.tpl>

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the service account

automountServiceAccountToken.description: whether to automount the SA token

create.description: Specifies whether a service account should be created.

name.description:
The name of the service account to use.
If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template

webApiUrl.description:
the base URL of the OHDSI WebAPI as seen by the browser, e.g. `https://example.com/WebAPI`.
Sets `api.url` in the generated `config-local.json`. Defaults to the relative `/WebAPI` path
which is served by the ingress or proxied to the WebAPI service by the ATLAS container itself.

cdmInitJob.description: define a custom init container to be run as part of the installation.

annotations.description: annotations set on the cdm-init Job

backoffLimit.description: the number of retries before considering the Job as failed

enabled.description:
if enabled, create a Kubernetes Job running the specified container as a `post-install` Helm hook.
see [cdm-init-job.yaml](templates/cdm-init-job.yaml) for the env vars
that are passed by default

image.description: the container image used to create the CDM initialization job

podAnnotations.description: annotations set on the cdm-init pod

resources.description: configure the resource requests and limits

More information: <https://github.com/chgl/charts/blob/master/charts/common/templates/_resources.tpl>

runOnUpgrade.description:
if enabled, the job is also run as a `post-upgrade` hook, i.e. on every `helm upgrade`.
Only enable this if the container is idempotent.

ttlSecondsAfterFinished.description: clean up Job and dependent objects after job completion <https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/job/#ttl-mechanism-for-finished-jobs>

common.description: values of the `common` library chart dependency

commonAnnotations.description: annotations applied to all deployments, jobs, and cronjobs

global.description: Global values are values that can be accessed from any chart or subchart by exactly the same name.

imagePullSecrets.description: image pull secrets used by all pods

annotations.description: provide any additional annotations which may be required. Evaluated as a template.

enabled.description: whether to create an Ingress to expose the Atlas web interface

kubernetes.io/ingress.class: nginx
kubernetes.io/tls-acme: "true"
the hosts to route `/atlas` and `/WebAPI` for. The origin of the first host is also used for the WebAPI's
CORS allowed origins and the OIDC callback URL.

ingressClassName.description: the name of the IngressClass to use

loadCohortDefinitionsJob.description: custom job to load cohort definitions into the WebAPI

auth.description:
WebAPI v3 denies anonymous users to create cohort definitions, so the job needs to authenticate
as a user with the appropriate permissions. If both are set, `apiKey` takes precedence over `db`.

existingSecret.description:
name of an existing secret containing a personal WebAPI API key (`wa_...`), sent as the `X-API-KEY` header.
See <https://github.com/OHDSI/WebAPI/blob/master/articles/APIKey_HOWTO.md>.

existingSecretKey.description: name of the key inside the secret whose value is the API key

existingSecret.description: name of an existing secret containing the user's password

existingSecretKey.description: name of the key inside the secret whose value is the password

login.description: login of a database authentication user. Requires `webApi.auth.basic.enabled=true`.

password.description: password of the database authentication user. Ignored if `existingSecret` is set.

backoffLimit.description: the number of retries before considering the Job as failed

cohortDefinitions.description:
the cohort defintions to send to the WebAPI as a list of JSON objects.
See the [ci/kitchen-sink-test-values.yaml](ci/kitchen-sink-test-values.yaml) file for an example of the expected format.

enabled.description:
whether to enable a job for loading custom cohort definitions in JSON format.
The job runs as a `post-install` and `post-upgrade` Helm hook and skips definitions whose `name` already exists.

podAnnotations.description: annotations set on the job's pod

postgres.description: The World's Most Advanced Open Source Relational Database

enabled.description: Conditional property used in parent chart
enabled.title: enabled

postgres.title: postgres

restrictedContainerSecurityContext.description: container security context applied to init containers and the Helm test pods

automountServiceAccountToken.description: whether to automount the SA token for the Helm test pods

resources.description: configure the test pods resource requests and limits

resourcesPreset.description:
set container resources according to one common preset (allowed values: none, nano, micro, small, medium, large, xlarge, 2xlarge). This is ignored if primary.resources is set (primary.resources is recommended for production).
More information: <https://github.com/chgl/charts/blob/master/charts/common/templates/_resources.tpl>

adminLogins.description: Comma-separated logins to grant the built-in admin role at authentication (`security.admin-login`).

enabled.description:
enable securing access to the WebAPI using database authentication (`security.auth.db`).
Requires an `auth_user` table to exist within the `schema` below. See
<https://github.com/OHDSI/WebAPI/blob/master/articles/DatabaseAuth_HOWTO.md> for details.

schema.description:
schema inside the database specified in `.Values.webApi.db` which contains the `auth_user` table.
If unset, defaults to `.Values.webApi.db.schema`.

existingSecret.description: name of an existing Kubernetes secret containing the JWT signing secret

existingSecretKey.description: name of the key inside the secret whose value is the JWT signing secret

secret.description:
the secret used to sign the JWTs issued by the WebAPI (`security.jwt.secret`).
If unset and `existingSecret` is empty, a random secret is generated and kept across upgrades.

callbackUI.description:
URL of the ATLAS UI OAuth callback the WebAPI redirects to after a successful login,
e.g. `https://example.com/atlas/#/oauth/callback`. Sets the `security.auth.oauth.callback.ui` property.
If unset, a URL is constructed from `ingress.hosts[0]`

enabled.description:
enable securing the WebAPI via an OpenId connect provider.
ATLAS automatically discovers the enabled auth providers from the WebAPI.
See "[Securing Atlas using OpenID Connect](#securing-atlas-using-openid-connect)" below

existingSecret.description: name of an existing Kubernetes secret containing the OpenId client secret

existingSecretKey.description: name of the key inside the secret whose value is the OpenId client secret

extraScopes.description: additional scopes to request, e.g. `email,profile`. Sets the `security.auth.oidc.extraScopes` property.

logoutUrl.description:
URL to be redirected to when logging out, e.g. the end-session endpoint of the OIDC provider.
Sets the `security.auth.oidc.logoutUrl` property.

oidUrl.description:
Required. Points to the issuer or openid-configuration endpoint of the provider,
e.g. `https://auth.example.com/realms/OHDSI/.well-known/openid-configuration`.
Sets the `security.auth.oidc.url` property.

rolesClaim.description:
name of the claim in the ID token containing the user's roles/groups.
Sets the `security.auth.oidc.rolesClaim` property.

allowedOrigin.description:
comma-separated list of allowed origins, e.g. `https://example.com,http://localhost:8080`.
Sets the `security.cors.allowed-origins` property, which the WebAPI v3 checks for all requests
whose `Origin` it doesn't consider its own, e.g. a login via `kubectl port-forward`.
If unset and `ingress.enabled=true`, the origin of `ingress.hosts[0]` (`<scheme>://<host>`) is used.
If unset and the ingress is disabled, the WebAPI's default of `http://localhost` is used.

database.description: name of the external database. Only used if `postgres.enabled=false`, otherwise `postgres.auth.database` is used.

existingSecret.description: name of an existing secret containing the password to the external database. Only used if `postgres.enabled=false`.

existingSecretKey.description: name of the key in `webApi.db.existingSecret` to use as the password to the DB.

host.description: database hostname of an external database. Only used if `postgres.enabled=false`.

password.description:
the database password. Only used if `postgres.enabled=false` and `existingSecret` is unset,
otherwise the secret created by the postgres chart is used.

port.description: port used to connect to the external database. Only used if `postgres.enabled=false`.

schema.description: schema used for the WebAPI's tables. Also referred to as the "OHDSI schema"

username.description: username used to connect to the external database. Only used if `postgres.enabled=false`, otherwise `postgres.auth.username` is used.
